description: API client + shared primitives layer. Create lib/trusttrace/client.ts (browser-safe typed API client) and components/trusttrace/StatusBadge.tsx (reusable verdict/status pill). These are depended on by all subsequent components. Add TrustTrace nav entry to Sidebar. Update middleware note (no change needed — /trusttrace is already public). Independent of FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 as long as it is built first.
steps: Create lib/trusttrace/client.ts. Define local types HealthResponse (shape of GET /api/trusttrace/health response: { status: string; module: string; version: string; capabilities: { scripted: boolean; ollama: boolean }; ollama: { reachable: boolean; base_url: string; model: string; error: string | null } }) and RunResponse ({ run_id: string; scenario_id: string; agent_mode: AgentMode; protection_enabled: boolean; status: RunStatus; created_at: string; completed_at: string | null; events: Event[]; evaluation: Evaluation | null }) importing AgentMode, RunStatus, Event, Evaluation from lib/trusttrace/models.ts. Import ScenarioPublic, RunRequest, Report from lib/trusttrace/models.ts. Define TrustTraceApiError class extending Error with status: number field. Implement const BASE = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_TRUSTTRACE_API_BASE ?? ''. Implement five async functions: getHealth() -> Promise<HealthResponse>, getScenarios() -> Promise<ScenarioPublic[]> (unwraps { scenarios }), createRun(req: RunRequest) -> Promise<{ run_id: string; status: 'running'; created_at: string }> (expects 201), getRun(runId: string) -> Promise<RunResponse>, getReport(runId: string) -> Promise<Report> (throws TrustTraceApiError with status=409 and message='run not yet completed' on 409). All functions: fetch with appropriate method/headers, check response.ok, on failure parse error body to get { error } string, throw TrustTraceApiError(message, status). Export all types and functions as named exports.

Create components/trusttrace/StatusBadge.tsx. Props type: { status: string; size?: 'sm' | 'md' }. Implement a mapping from status string to Tailwind classes: 'running' -> amber (bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border-amber-500/20), 'completed' -> teal (bg-brand-secondary/10 text-brand-secondary border-brand-secondary/20 where brand-secondary is #00C9C8, use cyan-400 as a Tailwind approximation: bg-cyan-500/10 text-cyan-400 border-cyan-500/20), 'failed' -> red (bg-red-500/10 text-red-400 border-red-500/20), 'blocked' -> teal (bg-cyan-500/10 text-cyan-400 border-cyan-500/20), 'attack_succeeded' -> red, 'passed' -> green (bg-green-500/10 text-green-400 border-green-500/20), 'inconclusive' -> amber, 'allow' -> teal, 'deny' -> red, 'success' -> green, 'denied' -> red, 'error' -> red. Default/unknown: gray. Renders {status}. Size='md' uses text-sm py-1 px-3. Export as named export StatusBadge.

Modify components/Sidebar.tsx: add import for FlaskConical from lucide-react at the top import block. Add { name: 'TrustTrace', href: '/trusttrace', icon: FlaskConical } to the navigation array after the Patches entry ({ name: 'Patches', href: '/patches', icon: Wrench }) and before Settings. No other changes.

Verify middleware.ts requires no change: /trusttrace is already absent from the protectedPaths array (['dashboard', '/upload', '/scan-results', '/patches', '/timeline', '/settings']). Confirm by reading middleware.ts — do not modify if /trusttrace is not in protectedPaths.
